an4.84:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.84:1.3: Kodhagaru hoti na saddhammagaru, makkhagaru hoti na saddhammagaru, lābhagaru hoti na saddhammagaru, sakkāragaru hoti na saddhammagaru.
an4.84:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 2.
an4.84:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.84:2.3: Saddhammagaru hoti na kodhagaru, saddhammagaru hoti na makkhagaru, saddhammagaru hoti na lābhagaru, saddhammagaru hoti na sakkāragaru.
an4.84:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ evaṃ sagge ti. 85.1 1.
